title: Tokenization of RWAs Data Curation
tagline: Project about tokenization of real-world assets curated list
description: Integrating a token curated list platform to create lists of real-world assets, as well as validating projects tokenizing RWAs, in order to avoid scams. Real-world assets would only be added to this list if they complied with the necessary due diligence requirements. The community would use badges to classify the type of token that was used in the tokenization process,the authenticity or not of any NFTs used, if compliance and risk assessments were done on the asset, as well as the status  the status on the auditing of the smart contracts governing it, amongst other things.
how_its_made: Still in ideation phase, but it would directly integrate a curation product in order to create data curation lists, where users could vote on the validity of an asset as well as on the trustworthiness of a tokenization platform. Unfortunately, I don't have the necessary coding skills to describe how this would work.
